title: FDA raises bar for foreign site inspections as China trials surge
snippet: Inspection access is not “an administrative footnote,” leaders of key FDA divisions wrote in an editorial on Wednesday vowing to expand oversight of foreign clinical trial sites.

title: Follow the money: How funding announcements can help identify jobs before they’re posted
snippet: Funding announcements can signal future hiring activity, giving biotech professionals a chance to build relationships before positions are posted. Industry experts share how to identify the funding events, milestones and company indicators most likely to lead to new jobs.

title: UniQure files for FDA, UK approval of first gene therapy for Huntington’s disease
snippet: The biologics license application follows months of public speculation—and regulatory reversals—for uniQure’s AMT-130. If accepted by the FDA for priority review, approval could come in the second quarter of 2027.
